name: Meenakshi Raman
headline: 73, field associate for a university ethnobotany study, Kodaikanal
description: Meenakshi started last month as a field associate for a university ethnobotany study in Kodaikanal. She spent her life cleaning houses and raising four children, and now she walks the forest paths before dawn to record which plants local women use for fever. She insists that every community healer who shares knowledge be listed as a co-researcher, and she gives half her modest stipend to a girl in her village.
